lines.text: Some children read slowly. That isn't the problem. *The test is.*
*Learnigo* turns reading, maths and science practice into short, kind games, for every kind of mind.
Pick a world: *English Kingdom*, *Maths Galaxy* or *Science Lab*.
Rounds are just ten questions, and *every question is read aloud*.
No buzzer. No red marks. Children *beat their own best*, not each other.
Got a question? Ask the *AI teacher*. It draws the answer on a board, and explains it out loud.
When it's time to move, *60+ camera games* turn reaching, freezing and copying into learning.
Parents, teachers and schools each get their *own view of progress*.
In *14 languages*, right in the browser.
Learnigo is *free for families*. Start at *learnigo.eu*
